Title: User Registration Login and Profile Verification
Preconditions:
1. Browser is available and can access https://practicesoftwaretesting.com/
2. A unique email address and a valid password (uppercase lowercase and symbol) are prepared for registration
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to https://practicesoftwaretesting.com/auth/register
2. Enter valid registration details including first name last name unique email and valid password
3. Submit the registration form
4. Navigate to https://practicesoftwaretesting.com/auth/login
5. Log in using the registered email and password
6. Open the user profile or account area after successful login
Expected Result:
1. Registration completes successfully without error
2. User is able to log in with the registered credentials
3. Profile or account information displays the registered first name last name and email correctly

Title: Single-Product Checkout with Cash on Delivery and Invoice Confirmation
Preconditions:
1. Browser is available and can access https://practicesoftwaretesting.com/
2. User is registered and logged in OR will register and log in during the test
3. At least one in-stock product is available in the catalog
Test Steps:
1. Log in to the application if not already authenticated
2. Navigate to the product catalog on the home page
3. Select an in-stock product and add one unit to the cart
4. Open the cart and proceed to checkout
5. Complete the checkout Sign in step if required
6. Enter valid billing address details on the Billing Address step
7. Select Cash on Delivery as the payment method on the Payment step
8. Proceed to the final confirmation step and press Confirm twice to generate the invoice as noted in the assessment
9. Navigate to My Invoices and locate the generated invoice
Expected Result:
1. Product is added to the cart successfully
2. Checkout wizard progresses through Sign in Billing Address Payment and confirmation steps
3. Cash on Delivery is accepted as the payment method
4. Invoice is generated after the required confirmation actions
5. The invoice is visible under My Invoices for the logged-in user

Title: Multi-Item Cart with Quantity Update Full Checkout to My Invoices
Preconditions:
1. Browser is available and can access https://practicesoftwaretesting.com/
2. User is registered and logged in
3. At least two in-stock products are available in the catalog
Test Steps:
1. Log in to the application
2. Browse the product catalog and add two different in-stock products to the cart
3. Open the cart and update the quantity of at least one cart item
4. Verify the cart reflects the updated quantities and multiple line items
5. Proceed to checkout
6. Complete the Sign in step if required
7. Enter valid billing address details on the Billing Address step
8. Select Cash on Delivery as the payment method
9. Complete the final confirmation step including double-confirm behaviour for invoice generation
10. Navigate to My Invoices and review the generated invoice
Expected Result:
1. Multiple products are present in the cart
2. Quantity update is reflected correctly in the cart before checkout
3. Checkout completes successfully using Cash on Delivery
4. Invoice is generated and visible under My Invoices
5. Invoice corresponds to the completed order with multiple items and updated quantities

Title: Login with Invalid Credentials
Preconditions:
1. Browser is available and can access https://practicesoftwaretesting.com/
2. A registered user account exists OR a known non-existent email is available for negative testing
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to https://practicesoftwaretesting.com/auth/login
2. Enter an invalid email and/or invalid password combination
3. Attempt to log in
4. Observe the login result and whether secured application areas become accessible
Expected Result:
1. Login is rejected and the user is not authenticated
2. An appropriate error message or validation feedback is displayed
3. User is not redirected into secured checkout or account-only areas without successful authentication

Title: Checkout with Invalid or Incomplete Billing Details
Preconditions:
1. Browser is available and can access https://practicesoftwaretesting.com/
2. User is registered and logged in
3. At least one product is added to the cart
Test Steps:
1. Log in to the application
2. Add at least one product to the cart
3. Proceed to checkout
4. Complete the Sign in step if required
5. On the Billing Address step leave required billing fields empty or enter clearly invalid billing data
6. Attempt to continue to the Payment step or complete checkout
7. Observe validation behaviour on the billing step
Expected Result:
1. Checkout does not proceed to successful order completion with invalid or incomplete billing details
2. Appropriate validation message or field-level error is displayed for the billing step
3. User remains on or is returned to the billing step until valid billing details are provided

Title: Invoice Generation Double-Confirm Behaviour
Preconditions:
1. Browser is available and can access https://practicesoftwaretesting.com/
2. User is registered and logged in
3. At least one product is added to the cart
4. User has reached the final invoice confirmation step of checkout with valid billing details and Cash on Delivery selected
Test Steps:
1. Log in and add at least one in-stock product to the cart
2. Proceed through checkout and enter valid billing details
3. Select Cash on Delivery as the payment method
4. On the final confirmation step press Confirm once
5. Verify whether the invoice is generated and whether checkout indicates completion
6. Press Confirm a second time if the order is not yet completed
7. Navigate to My Invoices and check for a generated invoice after one confirm and after two confirms
Expected Result:
1. After a single Confirm action the invoice is not fully generated or the order is not completed as expected per assessment behaviour
2. After the second Confirm action the invoice is generated successfully
3. The completed invoice becomes visible under My Invoices for the logged-in user
